Definition: Organizations and departments within organizations plan and budget together
Application to these guidelines: National programmes for HIV, STIs and viral hepatitis and other relevant health programmes review these guidelines, and use them to inform the development of integrated strategies, plans, budgets, guidelines and protocols for key populations.

Definition: Different clinical services integrated at organizational level, through coordinated referral or linkage
Application to these guidelines: Clinical service managers at different levels and for different clinical services review these guidelines, and work together to ensure key population members’ access to the comprehensive package of health interventions across health services, through referral or linkage.

Definition: Provision of multiple interventions at one site
Application to these guidelines: Site level managers of primary health care, community-based or other clinics, which serve key populations, are supported to provide multiple, appropriate, evidence-based interventions, as included in the WHO recommended package.
